Finish Your Apprenticeship Strong with a Global Industry Leader  
   Calling 3rd & 4th Year Air Conditioning & Refrigeration Apprentices in Sydney   
  This isn't your average HVACR apprenticeship.  
 You'll work on advanced commercial cooling systems alongside experienced technicians, building the technical skills and confidence to become a highly capable tradesperson. 
  What You'll Be Doing  
  No two days are the same . You'll work alongside experienced technicians across a variety of commercial sites, gaining hands-on experience with industry-leading equipment while developing skills that will set you apart in the trade. 
  You'll gain hands-on experience in:  
 
 Installing, servicing and maintaining commercial air conditioning and refrigeration systems 
 Advanced fault-finding, diagnostics and technical problem solving 
 Installing cabling, wiring and power/optic systems 
 Working on switchboards, grid systems and critical infrastructure 
 Working directly with customers while developing your communication and technical skills. 
 
  Who We're Looking For  
 
 A current 3rd or 4th Year Air Conditioning & Refrigeration Apprentice 
 Mechanically minded with a genuine passion for the trade 
 Curious, motivated and eager to expand your technical knowledge 
 A proactive problem solver who enjoys a challenge 
 Reliable, professional and enjoys working as part of a high-performing team 
 Current and valid driver's licence 
 White Card 
 
  Why You'll Love This Opportunity  
 ? Learn from highly experienced technicians every day 
 ? Work on complex commercial systems, not repetitive domestic installations 
 ? Optional overtime available to boost your earnings 
 ? Supportive team that invests in your development and career growth 
 ? Build valuable experience with a globally recognised organisation 
 ? Complete your apprenticeship while setting yourself up for a rewarding long-term career 
  About Our Host Employer  
 MEGT has partnered with a global leader in critical infrastructure solutions. They provide cooling, power and IT systems that support businesses and data centres across Australia. Based in Bella Vista, NSW, you'll join a supportive team that values quality workmanship, continuous learning and investing in the next generation of skilled tradespeople. 
  Ready to Take Your Career to the Next Level?  
 If you're a motivated 3rd or 4th Year Air Conditioning & Refrigeration Apprentice looking for greater technical exposure, more variety and the opportunity to learn from experienced technicians, we'd love to hear from you. 
 We'll support you through the transfer process, making the move as smooth as possible, so you can finish your apprenticeship with an industry leader and build a rewarding long-term career. 
  Apply today and take the next step in your HVACR career or  visit https:// https://www.megt.com.au/jobs  
 At MEGT, we enable people to start their careers through Apprenticeships and Traineeships and support large and small businesses to recruit, train and grow careers. Our purpose is to provide life changing, lifelong learning and employment solutions for all. We invite you to be part of our story. By applying, you agree to receive information about other MEGT employment and education opportunities 
 MEGT is committed to being a Child Safe Organisation and an Equal Opportunity Employer. We have zero tolerance of racism, discrimination, harm, or abuse. We have a culture that values safety, diversity, and inclusion and encourage all qualified applicants, including minorities, genders, protected veterans, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Prince of Wales Hospital - Clinical Nurse Consultant Grade 2, Intensive Care Unit

Join Prince of Wales ICU Team - Clinical Nurse Consultant (Grade 2)

An exciting opportunity awaits for experienced and passionate nurses to step into a pivotal leadership role in our Intensive Care Unit!

We're looking for a Clinical Nurse Consultant (Grade 2) to bring expertise, innovation, and mentorship to our ICU team. 

If you're ready to take the next step in your career and make a real impact in critical care, we want to hear from you!

Benefits

Financial benefits - Salary packaging options - Up to $9K for living expenses, $2.6K meal & entertainment, Novated Leasing; and Discounted Private Health Insurance.

Work-life balance - Up to 12 allocated days off each year (for full-time employees) in addition to annual leave.

Professional growth - Learning and development opportunities, including in-house training with RTO My Health Learning.

Health & wellbeing - Discounted gym memberships with a Fitness Passport and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for employees and family members.

Career development - Opportunity to apply for Continuing Education allowance based on tertiary qualifications attained where applicable and to obtain personal regrade to Clinical Nurse Specialist Grade 1 status where relevant 

The Role

The vision for South Eastern Sydney Local Health District (SESLHD) is 'exceptional care, healthier lives'. SESLHD is committed to enabling our community to be healthy and well, and to providing the best possible compassionate care when people need it.

The Nursing and Midwifery - Our Strategy for Transforming Person Centred Cultures 2024-2029 guides our profession in the development of effective person-centred practice and healthful cultures within SESLHD. We advocate for shared decision-making, collaborative relationships, compassionate and person-centred leadership, and supporting innovative practices.

The nursing vision for Prince of Wales Hospital is 'Transforming Person-Centred Care Together'. This approach to all nursing practices ensures we collaborate together on all aspects of healthcare, inclusive of staff, placing the person at the centre of shared decision making underpinned by respect, mutual understanding and facilitated choice. 
 
As a Clinical Nurse Consultant in SESLHD you will play a pivotal role in clinical service and consultancy, clinical leadership, research, education and clinical services planning and management. 
 
The Clinical Nurse Consultant - ICU at Prince of Wales Hospital is an expert in the specialty of Intensive Care Nursing, and who has responsibility for supporting the needs of the ICU and providing consultancy to the broader hospital. 

You will be part of a team that strives to support each other to reach our potential, focus on what matters most and continue to be innovative in approaches to practice. 

Where You'll be Working

Prince of Wales Hospital and Community Health Service is a Level 6 Tertiary Referral Hospital with an inpatient bed base of 370. Each year we care for more than 70,000 patients in our Emergency Department and have around 50,000 admissions to the inpatient units. POWH offers an outpatient service and rural outreach service and provides more than 900,000 occasions of non-admitted patient care each year, including innovative virtual models of care. We have transitioned the majority of inpatient units and wards to the Acute Services Building (ASB) including a state of the art Emergency Department and Intensive Care Unit. POWH provides an exceptional staff experience and enhanced patient and family outcomes as a result of the provision of person-centred care.
 

Randwick Local council is renowned for our world-class beaches and supported by cafes and restaurants to tickle your taste-buds, Randwick's fascinating coastline and atmosphere will have you in awe the minute you arrive. Offering a mix of historic buildings, impressive beaches and coastal walks coupled with boutique restaurants, transport links and a vibrant nightlife, you'll never be short of things to do in this progressive community.

Selection Criteria
 

Registered with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) as a Registered Nurse- Midwife

Have at least 5 years full time equivalent post registration experience, with at least 3 years full time equivalent experience in Intensive Care Nursing. In addition, must have approved postgraduate nursing qualifications relevant to the field in which he-she is appointed, or such other qualifications or experience deemed appropriate by the public hospital or public health organisation. An employer may also require a higher qualification in the specialist nursing field where such a qualification is considered essential for the performance of the individual position.

Demonstrated ability to apply clinical expertise in a consultant role and the ability to work independently.

Proven clinical leadership skills and an ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary framework with a demonstrated commitment to excellence in nursing practice.

Demonstrated evidence of the use of critical thinking as it relates to the delivery of advanced evidenced based nursing care.

Demonstrated experience in leading and implementing change, and developing direction in clinical practice by initiation, utilisation, review and translation of evidence-based research into practice, within a person-centred framework.

Demonstrated effective interpersonal skills, excellent written and verbal communication skills, advanced computer skills and use of software programs to analyse data and produce reports.

Demonstrated ability to contribute to strategic and clinical service planning.

result.description:
## Network Administrator
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and proactive Network Administrator to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and security of our organisation's network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in network administration, a methodical approach to troubleshooting, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly across all levels of the business. This role suits a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to delivering reliable, efficient IT services.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain network hardware, software, servers, and workstations, ensuring systems are kept up to date and performing optimally
- Monitor network performance on an ongoing basis, identifying and resolving issues proactively to minimise disruption to business operations
- Diagnose and troubleshoot network faults, emergencies, and connectivity issues, documenting resolutions and maintaining accurate records of all incidents and modifications
- Develop, maintain, and update procedures and documentation for network inventory, configuration changes, and maintenance instructions
- Manage user accounts, access permissions, and password policies in line with the organisation's security standards and compliance requirements
- Provide network programming and scripting support to address specific business needs and improve the efficiency of network operations
- Administer and support servers, printers, and personal computers, ensuring hardware resources remain reliable and fit for purpose
- Evaluate and implement upgrades to network infrastructure, recommending improvements that align with business growth and evolving technology requirements
- Deliver helpdesk support and technical assistance to end users, resolving issues in a timely manner and escalating complex problems where necessary
- Conduct user training and produce clear guidance materials to build internal capability and promote best practice use of network systems
- Maintain network security protocols, including firewall management, intrusion detection, and vulnerability assessments, to safeguard organisational data and systems
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to coordinate service delivery, procurement, and project implementation
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related discipline
- Proven experience in a network administration or systems administration role within a corporate or enterprise environment
- Strong working knowledge of networking protocols, infrastructure components, and technologies including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, LAN/WAN, and firewalls
- Demonstrated experience installing, configuring, and managing servers, switches, routers, and associated network hardware
- Proficiency in network monitoring and diagnostic tools, with the ability to analyse performance data and respond to anomalies
- Solid understanding of network security principles, including access control, patch management, and risk mitigation
- Experience maintaining technical documentation, network inventories, and fault resolution records to a high standard
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work methodically under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders
- Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment
## Preferred Qualifications
- Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA/CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or equivalent
- Experience with virtualisation platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure and hybrid network environments
- Experience working within ITIL frameworks or other structured IT service management methodologies
- Exposure to scripting or automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, or Ansible to streamline network operations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive, forward-thinking team that values continuous learning and invests in your professional development through training and certification opportunities
- Enjoy genuine flexibility with a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance
- Work on diverse and challenging infrastructure projects that will broaden your technical expertise and keep your skills at the cutting edge
- Join an organisation with a strong culture of collaboration, where your contributions are recognised and your ideas are encouraged
- Competitive remuneration package with long-term career pathways and opportunities for progression within a growing business
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Superannuation
